relationshipRules.NEGOTIATION: external trusted matched pins required before dispatch; old decoder rejects new profile/second frame, new rejects old/missing context/unknown version; no auto detection
relationshipRules.HEADER: exact18 unchanged names per D1 same-shape version proposal, source22/actual23 and frozen null rules; original raw retained
relationshipRules.EVIDENCE: declared/observed/unavailable/not-applicable distinct; observed has actual raw/artifact evidence, never expected copied
relationshipRules.CONTEXT: context ordinal1 unique, full explicit business material, all same run and selected inventory, no self pin
relationshipRules.INVENTORY: unique full/selected IDs original sealed order; H exact arrays; full417 B1single; actual bytes not counts only
relationshipRules.TREE: exact approved builtins or exact owner record adapter, no arbitrary attr/repr/str; bytes and list/tuple/map order preserved; unsupported codec blocks
relationshipRules.LAYOUT: all return fields per exact owner layout, original metadata unknown blocks compatibility; no tail stripping
relationshipRules.PIECES: base64 rawsize/hash exact, every original returned field including payload/rows/wire/sidecars/source retained; output incomplete cannot returned-complete
relationshipRules.STAGES: within each observation dependency chain, preserve earliest actual stage rejection and derived not-reached later stages; known business rejection can be fully collected and next observation continues. Only collection/protocol/unknown/source-binding failure blocks full run completeness; all prior returned pieces retained
relationshipRules.RAW: full byte streams and range identity; malformed keeps actual range/null record, no expected reconstruction
relationshipRules.RANGES: ranges nonnegative, bounded within same full raw, each complete frame covers original line excluding LF, no dropped bytes/hidden extra lines
relationshipRules.FRAME: contiguous ordinals/context-first/terminal-last, one run, unknown frame/version rejects without fallback
relationshipRules.ARTIFACTS: all pieces exact bytes and roles, IDs unique; derive/copy does not grant same identity
relationshipRules.SAME-ISSUE: actual approved verifier/source handle and original witness required for observed-match; session/issue strings no authority
relationshipRules.METADATA: opaque bytes preservation distinct semantic compatibility; unknown codec/layout/recipe preserves null/pending, no display source into helper
relationshipRules.IDENTITY: one owned graph domain, explicit all RDF slots and live graph-consumer witness; no label-based crossartifact merge
relationshipRules.MAPPING: schema both sides→wire each side→one bijection per owned domain→full other exact; original digest unchanged, separate relation witness
relationshipRules.HASH: raw SHA vs H tags separated; self/future fields excluded; terminal prefix excludes itself; caller hashes complete raw after termination
relationshipRules.TERMINAL: parsed selected inventory, all reached stage pieces and required source/identity guards, actualexit0; known-rejection/unsupported/missing-context/not-executed stay actual complete observation states, never original-operation pass; firstCollectionFailure distinct case canonical rejection
relationshipRules.FAILURE: first collection failure preserved at run level, earliest canonical rejection preserved per observation/stage; no arbitrary resource substitution; dispatcher failure not not-started; controlled lifecycle witnesses complete
relationshipRules.CARRIER: all mandatory original materials mapped; compatible unknown or missing witness/piece forbids collected; null availability exact
relationshipRules.FILES: caller/root fixed approved witness roots and full manifest; probe does not dereference external file refs
relationshipRules.BINDING: raw→carrier→business binding/comparison→complete manifest→receipt3; binding never future receipt-ref. All attempts including not-started retained; not-started runCore=null, buildReceipt actual available or null; dispatched core has complete raw and nullable header/terminal availability. receipt3.files includes explicit binding/carrier and contract compares same attempt/run/raw/build票, no added strict receipt key.
relationshipRules.PINS: all real repository/root/source/spec/codec/verifier/composition pin approvals external and exact; null until actually supplied/received; syntactic pin shape/version does not authenticate

hashPreimages.input: {codecId,layoutId,tree} new export only; never old raw digest
